**sdd/issue-246-c3/tasks**

**What**: openspec/changes/issue-246-c3/tasks.md — 6-phase TDD task breakdown for the `plainfiles` memory backend (C3, #246). STATUS: 36/36 tasks COMPLETE (all checkboxes `[x]` in the file) — see sdd/issue-246-c3/apply-progress (obs #582) for the full implementation report, TDD evidence, and final gate results.

**Why**: Orchestrator requested sdd-tasks phase for issue-246-c3 per spec.md (REQ-C3-1..6), design.md (op signatures, budget ~280-345), and the owner ruling in engram obs #578 (actorKind door-typed constant + 2 hardenings + engram.search stub).

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-246-c3/tasks.md (all 36 checkboxes marked `[x]`, plus a new "Apply-time notes" section documenting 2 sanctioned deviations: the doc-tripwire guard inlined into its test file, and JSDoc trimmed for budget). Implementation: brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs (new), brain/scripts/memory/lib/unsupported-op.mjs (new), format.mjs/engram.mjs/cli.mjs (modified), i18n/en.mjs+es.mjs (modified). Authoritative non-test counted diff: 364 lines (under the 400 budget) — single PR, no chain, no size:exception.

**Learned**: featureCheckpoint does NOT literally stamp an actorKind field — Hardening 1's consistency test was resolved as a STRUCTURAL/signature assertion (task 3.1), confirmed already-green given 2.3's implementation (task 3.2 required no code change). Review Workload Forecast held: Low risk, single PR — confirmed by the actual apply (364 counted lines vs the ~280-345 forecast, after trimming an initial 573-line overrun).
